subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR carry an internal multi-pass compaction engine now, or should it be narrowed to only the wired pruning and summary-boundary pieces until the broader compaction architecture is accepted?
rationale: The branch contains useful wired changes, but it also carries a large unintegrated multi-pass engine and exported settings fields that affect session-state/API direction beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Narrow To Wired Pieces
options.body: Keep only the pruning, summary-boundary, and cut-point fixes that are wired into production after rebase, and leave the multi-pass engine to the architecture issue.

options.title: Sponsor Multi-Pass Architecture
options.body: Accept the broader direction, but require production integration, public/API boundary cleanup, and live session proof before merge.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer the narrower open compaction candidates to own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Wired Pieces
recommendation.body: Keep only the pruning, summary-boundary, and cut-point fixes that are wired into production after rebase, and leave the multi-pass engine to the architecture issue.
